import json, os
from leave.models import LeaveBalance, LeaveRequest
k = int(os.environ['SMOKE_REQUEST_ID'])
item = LeaveRequest.objects.select_related('employee', 'decided_by').get(pk=k)
balance = LeaveBalance.objects.get(user__username='smoke-employee')
print(json.dumps({'request_count': LeaveRequest.objects.count(), 'id': item.id, 'employee': item.employee.username,
  'status': item.status, 'decided_by': item.decided_by.username if item.decided_by_id else None,
  'decided_at_set': item.decided_at is not None, 'start_date': str(item.start_date), 'end_date': str(item.end_date),
  'business_days': item.business_days,
  'balance': {'allowance': balance.allowance, 'used': balance.approved_days, 'available': balance.available_days}}))
